query: SELECT p.id, p.residentId, r.firstName, r.lastName, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.expirationEmailSent, p.createdAt FROM packages p LEFT JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id WHERE (p.totalHours - p.usedHours <= 0) AND p.expirationEmailSent = 0 ORDER BY p.residentId, p.createdAt DESC;
